note: Common Criteria (CC1–CC9) apply to every SOC 2; A/C/PI/P criteria apply when those categories are in scope.

criteria.name: Commitment to integrity and ethical values
Board of directors demonstrates independence and exercises oversight of internal control
Management establishes structures, reporting lines, authorities and responsibilities
Commitment to attract, develop and retain competent individuals
Individuals are held accountable for their internal control responsibilities
Quality information is obtained and used to support internal control
Internal communication of information, objectives and responsibilities for internal control
Communication with external parties about matters affecting internal control
Objectives are specified with sufficient clarity to identify and assess risks
Identifies and analyzes risks to the achievement of objectives
Potential for fraud is considered in assessing risks
Identifies and assesses changes that could impact the system of internal control
Evaluations are used to ascertain whether controls are operating
Internal control deficiencies are evaluated and communicated for corrective action
Control activities are selected and developed to mitigate risks to acceptable levels
Control activities over technology are selected and developed
Control activities are deployed through policies and procedures
Logical access security software, infrastructure and architecture are implemented to protect information
Registration and authorization of new internal and external users before granting access
Access is modified and removed on a timely basis (role change / termination)
Physical access to facilities and protected information assets is restricted to authorized personnel
Logical and physical protections over physical assets are discontinued only after data has been removed (secure disposal)
Security measures protect against threats from sources outside system boundaries
Transmission, movement and removal of information is restricted to authorized users and processes
Controls to prevent or detect and act upon the introduction of unauthorized or malicious software
Detection and monitoring to identify configuration changes and vulnerabilities
System components are monitored for anomalies indicative of security events
Security events are evaluated to determine whether they constitute incidents
Incidents are responded to through a defined incident response program
Identified incidents are resolved, and recovery is performed
Changes to infrastructure, data, software and procedures are authorized, designed, tested and approved
Risk mitigation activities are identified and developed for risks arising from potential business disruptions
Vendor and business partner risks are assessed and managed
Processing capacity is monitored and managed to meet availability objectives
Environmental protections, backup processes and recovery infrastructure are implemented
Recovery plan procedures supporting system recovery are tested
Information about processing objectives and specifications is obtained or generated and used
System inputs are complete and accurate
System processing is complete, accurate and timely
System outputs are complete, accurate and distributed only to intended parties
Stored inputs, items in processing and outputs are complete, accurate and protected
Confidential information is identified and maintained
Confidential information is disposed of to meet objectives
Notice is provided to data subjects about privacy practices
Choices regarding collection, use, retention, disclosure and disposal are communicated and consent obtained
Personal information is collected consistent with the entity's objectives
Explicit consent is obtained for collection of sensitive personal information where required
Personal information is collected, used, retained and disclosed consistent with the entity's objectives
Personal information is retained consistent with the entity's objectives
Personal information is securely disposed of
Data subjects can access their stored personal information
Data subjects can correct or amend their personal information
Personal information is disclosed to third parties only with consent or as permitted
Authorized disclosures of personal information are recorded
Unauthorized disclosures of personal information are recorded
Privacy commitments are obtained from vendors and third parties with access to personal information
Vendors and third parties notify the entity of unauthorized disclosures
Breaches and incidents are notified to affected data subjects, regulators and others
An accounting of disclosed personal information is provided to data subjects on request
Personal information is accurate, complete and relevant
Inquiries, complaints and disputes about privacy are received, addressed and resolved
